entries.description: Routed authoring of ai-assignment.md (analysis task; gemini-pro)

Authored docs/harvester/interpretation-guide-outline.md in-conversation (Opus orchestrator; matches the 'When the orchestrator's model matches the routing target' Convention for synthesis). Doc-home decision: docs/harvester/. Pointer page decision: docs/README.md.

Audience-check probe: queried gemini-pro + gpt-5-4 with the outline. Raw responses persisted per-model to probe-raw/ then combined into audience-check-probe.md; orchestrator synthesis to be added in the next edit.

Second audience-check probe attempt (gpt-5-4-mini first; sonnet fallback on OpenAI 429). OpenAI provider returned sustained 429 across multiple retries; fell back to Sonnet for the second probe data point. The probe is not fully cross-provider as a result (gemini-pro + sonnet, both non-OpenAI).
Cross-provider session-verification (query(gemini-pro fallback after OpenAI 429)).
Routed analysis: next-orchestrator recommendation for Session 2.

Authored docs/harvester/interpretation-guide.md in-conversation (Opus orchestrator; synthesis-heavy per project-guidance Convention). Sections 1-10 per outline; ~4,711 words within the 3,500-5,000 budget. Includes the three must-have JSON snippets (RowSourceSpec, FunctionClassification, EventHandlerClassification) and the embedded-macro XML shape sketch, plus all four nice-to-haves (kb mirror note, Diagnostics shape, Defaults.json pointer, relationship cardinality).
dotnet build / dotnet test — N/A per spec: docs-only session; no code touched.
Cross-provider session-verification routed via route(task_type='session-verification'); verifier=gemini-pro.
Routed analysis: next-orchestrator recommendation for Session 3 (model=gemini-pro).

Authored docs/README.md (the docs-index pointer page) in-conversation. Lists every doc in docs/ and its subdirectories with a one-line what-it-is/who-reads-it. Per Session 1 decision, the page lands at docs/README.md (consumer-discoverable from repo root).
Updated top-level README.md to add a link to the interpretation guide and to the new docs/README.md index, surfacing both for a fresh consumer landing on the repo root.

Downstream-AI probe per spec step 3. Routed via query(gpt-5-4, task_type=analysis) -> 429 fallback to query(gemini-pro). Prompt: full interpretation-guide.md + examples/northwind-output.json + structured-verdict JSON block. Verdict INSUFFICIENT, but the cause is stale examples/*.json (legacy pre-canonical-golden-output schema) rather than guide defect. Raw response persisted to probe-raw/downstream-ai-probe-gemini-pro.txt before any print side effect.

Spec stop rule "Out-of-date examples" tripped by the probe finding. Human adjudicated: honour the stop rule, do not close out Session 3 until examples/*.json is regenerated against the current canonical schema via tree-amendment to schema-finalization-and-docs. downstream-ai-probe.md authored documenting the verdict, root cause, and resume conditions. Session-state.json remains at status=in-progress; mark_session_complete() NOT called; end-of-session verification NOT run; disposition.json / change-log.md / next-session-set-recommendation.md NOT produced.

Per user direction, regenerated examples/*.json in-session rather than opening a tree-amendment to schema-finalization-and-docs (workflow deviation noted). Files replaced with verbatim copies from the canonical golden corpus: minimal-form.json <- HHC/ir/Forms/frmReportParam_ClientFY.ir.json (116 lines); complex-form.json <- HHC/ir/Forms/frmServiceDetail.ir.json (1045 lines); northwind-output.json <- NorthwindDevEdition/manifest.json (29-line envelope stub). Updated guide section 9 to describe the regenerated files accurately.

Re-ran downstream-AI probe (gemini-pro fallback after gpt-5-4 429) against the regenerated examples. Verdict SUFFICIENT WITH ADDITIONS with 2 blocking gaps (EventMacros object undocumented; On<event>EmMacro property pattern undocumented) and 3 nonblocking gaps. Raw response preserved at probe-raw/downstream-ai-probe-gemini-pro-v2-pre-gapfix.txt.

Addressed both v2 blocking gaps in the guide. Section 5.1: added EventMacros bullet (structured per-event Actions array), added On<event>EmMacro pattern to event-binding shape, added CodeBehindForm note to VbaCode bullet, added hex-blob note to Properties bullet. Section 5.6: cross-references the three-form embedded-macro story.

Re-ran downstream-AI probe after gap fixes (gemini-pro fallback after gpt-5-4 429). Verdict SUFFICIENT WITH ADDITIONS with 0 blocking gaps and 5 nonblocking gaps (TextCapacity, hex-blob context, EventMacros omission semantics, Label.source casing, canonical manifest.json filename). Spec gate cleared.

Folded the 5 v3 nonblocking gaps into the guide as polish. Section 2: added stable-filename sentence (manifest.json / unresolved-items.json). Section 5.1: added TextCapacity description (charsPerLine/visibleLines/font + unavailable form) and EventMacros omission semantics. Section 7: fixed Label.source casing from PascalCase to lowercase + added provenance-object vs. record-shape casing framing paragraph.

End-of-session cross-provider verification. Routed via route(task_type=session-verification) -> gpt-5-4 returned sustained 429s (third+ consecutive session). Per verifier-failure escalation ladder, fell back to query(gemini-pro, task_type=session-verification). Verdict VERIFIED, 0 issues, terse-but-JSON-block-compliant response.
